claims.value: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B-BF16 is a deployment-optimized large language model derived from Nemotron-3-Super-120B, produced using Iterative Puzzle compression framework to improve inference efficiency for interactive, reasoning-heavy, and long-context workloads while preserving accuracy.
claims.evidence: Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B is a deployment-optimized large language model developed by NVIDIA, derived from Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B. The model is produced using Iterative Puzzle, a post-training compression framework

claims.value: The model employs a hybrid MoE architecture with interleaved Mamba, MoE, and Attention layers. It has 75.3B total parameters and 9.3B active parameters. It supports Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for faster text generation.
claims.evidence: The model employs a hybrid MoE architecture with interleaved Mamba, MoE, and Attention layers. Like Nemotron-3-Super, it supports Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for faster text generation.

claims.value: Puzzle-75B-A9B reduces the parameter count from 120.7B total / 12.8B active in the parent model to 75.3B total / 9.3B active parameters.
claims.evidence: Compared to its parent, Puzzle-75B-A9B reduces the model from 120.7B total / 12.8B active parameters to 75.3B total / 9.3B active parameters.

claims.value: The supported languages for this model include English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish, and Chinese.
claims.evidence: The supported languages include: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Spanish, and Chinese.

claims.value: This model is intended for general purpose reasoning and chat, optimized for collaborative agents, high-volume workloads, AI Agent systems, chatbots, RAG systems, complex instruction-following, and long-context reasoning.
claims.evidence: NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-3-Puzzle-75B-A9B-BF16 is a general purpose reasoning and chat model intended to be used in English, Code, and supported multilingual contexts. This model is optimized for collaborative agents

claims.value: For long-context benchmarks, the model achieved 95.1% on RULER @ 256k, 94.2% on RULER @ 512k, and 92.2% on RULER @ 1M.
For reasoning benchmarks, the model scored 82.4 on MMLU-Pro, 89.7 on AIME25 (no tools), and 93.4 on HMMT Feb25 (no tools).
